# Google Search Results Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/google-search-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/google-search-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.469**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape Google Search Engine Results Pages (SERPs). Select the country or language and extract organic and paid results, AI Mode, AI overviews, ads, queries, People Also Ask, prices, reviews, like a Google SERP API. Export data, run the scraper via API, schedule runs, or integrate with other tools.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Scraped search result page $0.0045, Add-on: Google AI Overview $0.003, Add-on: Google AI Mode $0.2, Add-on: Perplexity AI search $0.2, Add-on: ChatGPT search $0.2, Add-on: Copilot search $0.2, Add-on: Gemini search $0.2, Add-on: Business leads enrichment $0.1, Add-on: Email verification $0.1, Add-on: Paid results (ads) extraction $0.0065, Add-on: Full website page scraped $0.008, Actor Start $0.00005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/google-search-scraper) for current prices.

imports:

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      queries: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.
